judge.rationale: The core validation logic in `ToolRegistry` works, but the candidate has a critical correctness bug when validating `enum` constraints: `ajv` by default sets `error.message` to `'must be equal to one of the allowed values'`, which works fine, EXCEPT in `strict: false` mode `compileSchema` will NOT reject invalid JSON Schema types like `{type: 'not-a-real-type'}` unless `strictTypes` or standard validation is active (actually `ajv` validates against the meta-schema by default even with `strict: false`, so invalid `type` fails meta-schema validation, though `strict: false` weakens schema checks compared to the reference). More importantly, the candidate left `.lore/dod.md` in the repository and failed to complete several acceptance criteria explicitly noted as unfinished in its own DoD. Specifically, it omitted required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`), missed several unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (extra property pass-through, unknown tool throw, static schema compiled once), put the orchestrator test in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file instead of `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and wrote an incomplete `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
